trajectory_summary: This is a short, low-friction reactivation call where the rep's main job was damage control on redundant dialer contact rather than re-selling solar. A time was locked, but the rep never re-established why this appointment matters to the customer — no bill, no interest reason, no re-anchor to the original solar design — leaving a mechanically booked appointment with no emotional glue.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (Monday) and time (10 AM) were both explicitly agreed on the call, meeting the booked threshold even though the button-up procedure was incomplete.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: No bill amount or usage figure is mentioned anywhere in this short reactivation call; the conversation stays entirely on scheduling logistics.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: The rep never asks why she's interested in solar or what prompted the original design request; the customer never volunteers a reason either — the entire call is address-confirmation and day/time negotiation.
